title: A BLE GATT sensor: service, characteristic, and notification

spans.text: BLE suits battery-powered sensors that send small readings to a phone using little energy. GATT services and characteristics define the data.

This sketch acts as a BLE peripheral. A phone is the central: it connects, reads the current value, and can subscribe to notifications for new readings. Install NimBLE-Arduino through Arduino IDE Library Manager; it supports BLE-capable ESP32 variants including S3, C3, and C6. In ESP-IDF, use its compatible NimBLE component instead of this Arduino library. Choose service and characteristic UUIDs for your application.

Notify at a sensible interval, measure power, and keep personal information out of advertisements. Visibility, pairing, and notification permissions are controlled by the phone app.

spans.title: Important safety and compatibility note
spans.text: Verify the NimBLE-Arduino version and BLE support for the selected board. Replace the sample with a real sensor; add access control and validation if readings are private. BLE is not Wi-Fi internet.
